card.name: Advisory wording before instructions or cautions
card.fires_on: Words that introduce a notice or instruction, such as "asked", "urged", "remind", "strongly" (before encouraged) and "Important" before administration or handling information.

modes.label: Public advisory verbs
modes.description: Verbs like asked, urged or remind after "are" or "to" in health-notice news text.
modes.example: To avoid the spread of the disease, hunters are<< asked>> to follow the above listed guidelines while transporting

modes.label: Important in label headings
modes.description: The word Important (or a colon after it) opening a drug-label heading or note about administration or handling.
modes.example: See additional<< important>> information in the Full Prescribing Information.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning warning, reminder and notification, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires on words that flag a notice or an important instruction is coming, such as urged, remind or Important.
